name: seal-walker-vscode
description: A tiny seal that walks along the bottom of your screen when VS Code opens.

sealWalker.launchOnStartup.description: Launch the seal automatically when VS Code finishes starting.

sealWalker.scale.description: Visual scale applied to each sprite frame.

sealWalker.speed.description: Walking speed in pixels per second.

sealWalker.bottomMargin.description: Distance in pixels between the seal and the bottom of the screen.

sealWalker.idleMinMs.description: Minimum time the seal stays in its initial idle pose before walking.

sealWalker.idleMaxMs.description: Maximum time the seal stays in its initial idle pose before walking.

sealWalker.walkMinSteps.description: Minimum random number of steps in one walking round.

sealWalker.walkMaxSteps.description: Maximum random number of steps in one walking round.

sealWalker.walkFrameMs.description: Frame duration for the walking loop. Higher values make the walk animation slower.

sealWalker.stepPauseMs.description: Pause duration between each walking animation pass.

sealWalker.walkMotionFrames.description: Number of leading walk frames that move the seal. Later frames finish the pose without sliding.

sealWalker.sleepFrameMs.description: Frame duration for sleeping and waking animations.

sealWalker.airFrameMs.description: Frame duration for air grab, fall impact, and recovery animations.

sealWalker.impactLoopFrameMs.description: Frame duration for the loop that plays on the floor after the seal falls.

sealWalker.tripleClickMs.description: Maximum time window in milliseconds for three clicks to trigger sleep or wake.

sealWalker.walkStartFrame.description: First spritesheet frame used for walking. Frame 0 stays as the idle/default seal.

sealWalker.framePadding.description: Transparent padding kept around each extracted sprite frame.

sealWalker.spriteColumns.description: Number of columns in the walking spritesheet.

sealWalker.spriteRows.description: Number of rows in the walking spritesheet.

scripts.check: node -c extension.js && node -c pet-app/main.js && node -c pet-app/preload.js && node -c pet-app/renderer.js
